description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering reporting methods in the OrangeHRM application, extending a base filter parameters class and setting a default sort field.

classes.name: ReportingMethodSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering and sorting parameters when searching reporting methods within the OrangeHRM's PIM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'rm.name'.
